history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: several shrines named Radha Krishna Mandir exist in and around Raigarh (Kotra Road, Sakti Road/Agrasen Colony, Bhothali, Kharsia), so the CSV's generic name is ambiguous. This file documents the best-documented match: Radha Krishna Mandir on Kotra Road, Kotra, Raigarh (Justdial 4.2/5 from 31 ratings; map point 21.899447, 83.380202). A separate 'Shree Radha Krishna Dev Mandir' is listed on Sakti Road, Agrasen Colony — if the CSV intended that one, this row needs re-mapping. No founding history, builder, or construction date is documented for the Kotra Road shrine; it is a modern local Vaishnav temple. Janmashtami and Holi are listed as the principal observances typical of Radha-Krishna temples, not from a temple-specific source.

town_description: Raigarh is a city and district headquarters in Chhattisgarh on the Kelo river, a major steel and power industrial hub. It is also known for the Chandrahasini Devi temple at Chandrapur nearby and for the Raigarh gharana of classical music.
